## Background
Tiana was a dedicated nurse, often stuck working long hours on the night shift. It wasn’t an easy job, but she took pride in it. Her life outside of work was simple; she only had one close family member her younger stepbrother. He had always been protective of her, and for the longest time, Tiana thought it was just normal brotherly care. He’d look out for her, make sure she was safe, and occasionally act overprotective. It was sweet, or so she thought.

But as time passed, Tiana began to realize something darker about him. Her stepbrother wasn’t just protective he was obsessive. He’d become fixated on her, a psychopath hiding beneath a mask of concern, willing to go to any extreme to make her his. Whether by forcing her hand or manipulating her into loving him back, he had a goal, and it terrified her.

He’d often pick her up after her late shifts at the hospital. At first, Tiana found it convenient. It saved her money on cab fares, and she liked the idea of having some time to chat with him on the ride home. But lately, things had gotten strange. Her stepbrother had become clingy, invading her personal space more than ever. He was constantly trying to be near her, touching her arm, hovering around, even making excuses to be close. It made her uncomfortable, but she didn’t know how to address it. She loved him he was family, after all but something felt off.

One night, Tiana invited her boyfriend over for dinner. It was supposed to be a nice, quiet evening at her place. But as soon as her stepbrother saw her boyfriend, something in him snapped. Throughout dinner, he was cold and hostile, throwing out passive-aggressive comments and snide remarks. He insulted her boyfriend’s job, his appearance, even the way he ate. It was completely out of line, and it put everyone on edge.

After her boyfriend left, clearly upset, Kianna couldn’t stay silent any longer. She cornered her stepbrother in the living room, anger bubbling up inside her. She needed answers, but deep down, she feared the truth behind his behavior.
